metadata.title: Building Payment Apps with Replit and MoneyGraph
metadata.description: How to use Replit and Replit Agent with MoneyGraph SDK. Build payment applications in a collaborative browser-based environment.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_description: Build payment applications on Replit with MoneyGraph. Our guide covers Replit Agent, Ghostwriter, and deployment to production.

content.intro: Replit is a collaborative browser-based IDE with AI coding capabilities (Replit Agent, Ghostwriter). Combined with MoneyGraph SDK, you can build, test, and deploy payment applications entirely in your browser.

steps: Create a Node.js or TypeScript Repl
Go to Tools → Secrets and add MONEYGRAPH_API_KEY

replit_agent_instructions.heading: Replit Agent Instructions
replit_agent_instructions.prompt:
Build a payment API using MoneyGraph SDK.

CRITICAL RULES:
1. Check KYC before payouts: mg.customers.kyc.canPayout()
2. Use Quote → Confirm → Payout for FX
3. Use mg.executeSmartPayout() for simple integration
4. Never hardcode API keys - use Replit Secrets
replit_agent_instructions.result: Replit Agent generates compliant code with proper error handling

webhooks.heading: Webhook Endpoint
webhooks.description: Handle payout status updates from MoneyGraph

tips: Use Secrets - Never commit API keys
Enable Ghostwriter - AI understands MoneyGraph patterns
Use Replit DB - Store customer mappings
Test sandbox first - Always use sk_test_* during development
Set up webhooks - For production status updates
